Messages.Author: David Naseby
Messages.Body:
Dial1411 wrote:

> When you play a trap card can you still manuever with you gun and use
> its
> strike?

Yes. You can only maneuver with the gun once per combat, though, and
each new round of combat starts at close range.

> And trap says to play before range is decdied can either player still
> play a
> combat card to manuever or is just whatever weapons that got?

You can use cards as you normally would in combat, including maneuvers,
presses and strikes. Trap just acts like you have played a press to
continue card at the end of each combat round. If you want to get out of
a trap, play a press to end. The trapper must play another press to
continue if they want the trap to continue.

David Naseby
